people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
translations.bsb: “How long will this wicked congregation grumble against Me? I have heard the complaints that the Israelites are making against Me.
